summary: Frontend-only verification of Dashboard restructure, Orientation skip, and new /for-professionals page. All 7 acceptance criteria from the review request PASS end-to-end after logging in as parent1@test.com and clearing localStorage. First-time visitors now land on /dashboard (no auto-redirect to /orientation), the tour banner + CTA + dismiss button work and persist via localStorage key 'sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1'=true, the 4 front-door tiles are visible above the fold, and 'Explore All Tools' is collapsed by default hiding legacy prep-modules until expanded. /for-professionals renders publicly with the required testids (page, headline, supporting copy, 4 highlight cards, and 7 collapsible FAQs 0-6 all expand on summary click). Landing footer exposes both 'For professionals' and 'Sample library' links. Orientation skip button navigates to /dashboard and stamps the LS flag.

issues: 'Skip to dashboard' button uses text-[13px] (13px font). It is purple + pill-shaped + bordered (matches spec), but visually understated. Consider bumping to text-sm/base and adding a solid purple background variant to make it truly 'prominent' as requested. Current classes: text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#3D1A78] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#3D1A78] border border-[#3D1A78] rounded-full px-4 py-1.5

action_items: (Optional) Increase visual prominence of the /orientation Skip-to-dashboard pill: larger text size or solid purple fill by default rather than only on hover.
Note: Console logs show intermittent 405 responses on the dashboard (likely analytics/tour tracking POST). Not blocking, but worth verifying the endpoint handler accepts the correct HTTP verb.
critical_code_review_comments: Tour banner dismissal reuses the same localStorage key ('sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1') used by the Orientation skip flow. This works because both events mean 'user has been introduced'. Confirm this coupling is intentional — otherwise a user who takes/skips orientation later will not see the tour banner offer even if they never dismissed it. If independent state is desired, add a separate key such as 'sacoparents.dashboard_tour_dismissed.v1'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 review-request features verified via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Legal-acknowledgement modal must be dismissed on every page load — checkbox is a radix role=checkbox (not native input); use page.get_by_role('checkbox').click() then click 'I acknowledge — continue'. Login flow: /login → 'Sign in with email' toggle → email+password inputs → submit. LocalStorage key 'sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1' is stamped both when dismissing the dashboard tour banner AND when clicking the /orientation skip pill.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found for the requested features.
